name: tools-catalog-doctor
description: Offline CLI to validate tools/README.md catalog integrity: discover tool directories, check index completeness, detect duplicate sections

scripts.test:fixtures: npm run build && npm run test:fixtures:healthy && npm run test:fixtures:gutted && npm run test:fixtures:dup
scripts.test:fixtures:healthy: node dist/index.js --root fixtures/healthy && echo '✅ Healthy fixture passed'
scripts.test:fixtures:gutted: node dist/index.js --root fixtures/gutted && exit 1 || echo '✅ Gutted fixture correctly failed'
scripts.test:fixtures:dup: node dist/index.js --root fixtures/dup-sections && exit 1 || echo '✅ Dup-sections fixture correctly failed'
